audio: External tracks: exact sample count, tempo, channel extraction; keep film mix as primary.
background: Optional footage canvas and transparent layers; scene code already creates backgrounds.
batch: Optional external-media recipes/cache; not a second film authoring format; watch remains deadline-bound.
broll: Optional footage inserts; scene timeline remains primary.
caption: Subtitle muxing, multilingual tracks and alpha layers; reuse existing transcripts.
check: Written-file QC, SSIM/PSNR, declared changed spans/regions, legal YUV ranges and content diagnostics.
color: Footage HDR conversion, explicit matrix conversion, LUTs, legalization; retagging is not conversion.
crop: Optional exact external-footage crop; scene camera remains editable.
cropdetect: Black bars and per-second motion centroid; does not identify a subject.
cut: Footage smart H264 cut, VFR guard, beat snap, declick and source/output timemap.
deinterlace: Imported interlaced recordings only; no benefit for progressive scene renders.
denoise: Video cleanup for imported footage; audio denoise already has a separate adapter.
export: NLE masters, alpha/key-fill, size targets and measured repair/remux; inspect source carry.
freeze: Optional footage hold; scene timeline already handles freezes.
graphics: Optional transparent title/graphic layers; scene titles remain primary.
grid: Labeled footage A/B composites and comparison grids.
insert: Optional footage inserts; film timeline remains primary.
join: Verified concat, explicit missing/silent policies; avoid reencoding compatible clips.
look: Before/after PNGs, safe areas and guides; sheet/reference inspect remain primary for films.
loop: Optional crossfaded footage loops; measurements do not certify a perceptually seamless loop.
loudness: External-track measurement/normalization; dynamic fallback exists, never replace film mix implicitly.
metadata: Container chapters, language/title tags and proposed chapters; separate from existing BWF tools.
multicam: Audio-aligned recording switches; energy is not speaker identity.
overlay: Optional imported-footage compositing and alpha; scene overlays remain editable.
pad: Optional footage head/tail extensions; scene timing remains primary.
probe: Stream/HDR/SAR/rotation inventory, dotted fields and nearby keyframes.
proxy: Small consistent copies for external-media inspection; preserve original sources.
redact: Known-region blur/pixelation only; no automatic face/identity detection guarantee.
render: Optional reproducible external-media recipes, fingerprinted plans/cache and rough-cut NLE handoff.
report: Optional self-contained before/after evidence HTML; not creative approval.
reverse: Optional footage reversal; scene timing remains primary.
scenes: Alternative motion/energy evidence; keep PySceneDetect/reference/earshot as primary.
sequence: Verified still-sequence assembly for rendered-frame handoff.
silence: Source/output timemap, asymmetric/sentence-aware margins; do not remove breaths automatically.
speedramp: Piecewise constant footage speed; does not replace continuous scene speed curves.
sphere: 360-footage viewport extraction; scene cameras remain primary.
stabilize: Optional imported-footage stabilization; keep intentional camera motion.
sync: Recording audio offset/confidence and clock drift; not mouth/lip-sync verification.
verify: Developer media smoke harness; not normal preflight; ignores native dry-run.
waveform: Channel-separated waveform/spectrum video; earshot and audio models still interpret sound.
